m: {Lisa Simpson} marches into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} with a petition for fair pay, and finds a *servant* scrubbing the tiles with a toothbrush. She plays a sad saxophone solo and hands out leaflets. The **servant** bows politely and keeps scrubbing, because even a **servant** who has just been given a petition still has a floor to finish.

{Lucifer} makes a cheeky deal in the {Basement} of the {Shed}: a *lying man* must pace *back and forth* across the floor a hundred times, no shortcuts. Lucifer counts every lap with a puff of smoke and a poke of the pitchfork. The man **fulfils** his side of the deal, and Lucifer sulks, because a deal **fulfilled** means no prize for him.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} as he loads a *stretched bow* with his squirting flower and fires *water drops* at the floor. Drip by drip, the puddle begins to **rise**: ankles, knees, hat. His trick playing cards float like tiny boats, and the Joker grins as the water **rises** to his chin.

{Yoda} hobbles into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} beside a *torchbearer* whose torch blazes like a small sun. A *pheasant* struts past, and the light hits its feathers: gold, ruby, emerald. '**Brilliant**, this bird is,' says Yoda, squinting. It shines so **brilliant** that the old master has to put on sunglasses and still sees spots.

{Nemo} paddles into the {Basement} of the {Boathouse}, where a *clown* is twisting long balloons into animals. A *helping hand* grabs Nemo's little fin and gives it a friendly tug. The clown **twists** a balloon into a pretzel, and the hand **twists** Nemo round and round until the little fish spins like a corkscrew, giggling and dizzy.

{Tony Stark} blasts into the {Inside} of the {Mansion} with a heap of *soil* and a puffy *cloud* he has built a gadget to carry. He piles the soil into a neat platform and parks the cloud on top as incense. JARVIS dims the lights: a perfect **altar**. Tony bows his head before the **altar** and, for once, does not make a single joke.

{Batman} swoops to the {Front} of the {Fort} where a giant old rotary telephone stands on a *launch pad*. A *helping hand* from his utility belt reaches out and **dials**, one finger in each hole. Round it whirs, click, click, click. Batman growls into the receiver, because the only number he knows how to **dial** is Alfred's.

{Wonder Woman} lassos a *dancer* and twirls her through the {Bathroom} of the {Fort}, sprinkling *water drops* from a golden bucket. Wherever the drops land, the tiles sprout wheat, tomatoes and sunflowers. The ground is so **fertile** that her tiara grows leaves. She plants her fists on her hips and declares the whole fort **fertile**.

{Houdini} is chained in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} cabin, so he pulls a *silk thread* from his sleeve. A crowd waits in a *meeting room* next door, and with the thread he **draws** a perfect door on the wall, then steps through. They applaud: only Houdini can **draw** his own escape. Ta-da!

{Fred Flintstone} yabba-dabba-doos into the {Inside} of the {Spa} with a *lumberjack* and a stone axe. Together they **cut down** the potted palms, the towel stand and even the sauna door, while Dino drags the logs away. 'Timber!' roars Fred. The lumberjack nods proudly: that is how you **cut down** a spa.

{King Kong} stomps up to the {Front} of the {Mansion} carrying an *overflowing bowl* of hot stew and a heap of *soil* for the garden. The bowl sloshes, soup scalds his thumb, birds peck his fur. Kong cannot **endure** it, and then he does: he beats his chest and **endures** every drop without spilling a spoonful.

{Winnie the Pooh} sits in the {Inside} of the {Shed} with his head stuck in a honey pot. A *standing person* in a bow tie, his faithful **servant**, shakes a *fortune stick* to see whose turn it is to pull. The stick falls: the **servant** it is. Tug, tug, pop! Pooh says oh bother and reaches for another pot.

{Gru} stands at the {Front} of the {Fort}, aiming his freeze ray at a long *city wall*, because he has spotted a sign painted on it. A Minion holds up a mailbox. Gru reads aloud: **Guo**. It is a family name, the **Guo** family lives behind the wall, and Gru sheepishly lowers his ray and knocks politely.

{Shiva} dances in a ring of fire at the {Front} of the {Shed} while a *cow* wanders toward a signpost pointing *west*. Villagers prepare a **sacrifice**, but Shiva, kind and majestic, raises a palm to stop it and offers a **sacrifice** of his own: his most beautiful dance. The cow walks off west, safe and happy.

{Jim Carrey} bursts into the {Front} of the {Mansion} in the Mask's green face and zoot suit, ready to **annihilate** a *thousand ants* marching toward the birthday cake. 'Smokin'!' he cries, spinning into a cartoon tornado. A rattling *skeleton* from the closet plays the xylophone on its own ribs. Poof! Every ant is **annihilated**, and not one crumb is lost.

{Muhammad Ali} shuffles into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} at *sunset*, rhyming that he will float like a butterfly past the great stone **tomb**. A pile of *soil* covers its door, so he shadow-boxes it clean in seconds. 'I am the greatest, and this is the greatest **tomb**,' he says softly, and lays a flower on it.

{Gru} pins a notice on the *door* in the {Bathroom} of the {Shed}: Wanted, one evil assistant. A tiny *sparrow* flutters in with a resume in its beak. Gru decides to **hire** it on the spot, and the newly **hired** sparrow salutes with one wing and starts helping to steal the moon, one crumb at a time.

{Lisa Simpson} wheels a lost garden *shed* into the {Inside} of the {Mansion}, stacked with *two sheaves* of wheat she found in the street. She could keep them, but she returns every stalk to the owner with a neat receipt. Everyone gasps at such an **honest** girl. She plays a proud saxophone solo for the most **honest** day of her life.

{Chip} scampers into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} with an acorn deal to settle. A *big man* chisels a *carving* in a log: the **contract**, saying Chip gets every acorn. Chip signs with a squeaky pawprint. Dale sneaks in to cross something out, but the **contract** is carved in wood and cannot be changed.

{Pikachu} sparks at the {Front} of the {Funfair}, where a toy train set lies in a hundred pieces. A *helping hand* snaps the *linked rails* together, and Pikachu zaps each joint so it fuses. Pika! He and the hand **piece together** the whole track, and the little engine toots, delighted that the puzzle is **pieced together**.

{Charlie Chaplin} waddles into the {Inside} of the {Jungle} in huge *marching boots* that squelch in the mud. He mimes a stern judge wagging a finger at a monkey that stole his bowler hat. He wants to **punish** it, but the monkey presses a hand on its *heart*, and Chaplin cannot **punish** it. He just tickles it.

{Judy Hopps} hops to the {Front} of the {Fort} to catch a runaway pie thief. A *helping hand* shoots out to **grab** his collar, but he wriggles free and runs, and Judy leaps high, ticket book flapping, to land with a *foot* on his shadow. She **grabs** his belt and writes a very fast ticket.

{Nick Fury} stalks into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed}, eyepatch glinting, and barks an order: **cover** the top-secret *cabinet* at once. Agents run *back and forth* with sheets, blankets and a giant flag. Soon the whole cabinet is **covered**, and only Fury knows what hides underneath. Nobody dares to lift the cloth.

{Shuri} unveils her latest invention at the {Front} of the {Spa}: a vibranium handle shaped like a *standing knife*, with a bristly *dustcloth* head. She switches it on, and it **brushes** the wall, the floor and her brother's shoes at sonic speed. The humming **brush** leaves everything gleaming.

{Jim Carrey} tiptoes into the {Inside} of the {Hut} as a cartoon bandit in a striped shirt, ready to **rob** the cookie jar. A rubber *strong arm* stretches across the room to snatch it, and he sprints for the *exit*, pulling a face after every step. Caught, the silly **robber** puts the cookies back and takes a bow.

{Shiva} dances in a ring of fire in the {Inside} of the {Mansion} while a *woman* holds up *two sheaves* of wheat and wrinkles her nose. She **dislikes** the left sheaf, she **dislikes** the right sheaf. Shiva, with four arms, offers four other gifts at once, and she **dislikes** those too, so he simply keeps dancing.

{Gru} aims his shrink ray at a giant *melon* at the {Front} of the {Spa}. Zap: it shrinks to a grape. He tries his freeze ray, and the **melon** turns to ice. The Minions roll the frozen **melon** down the hall like a bowling ball, and Gru, who only wanted a smoothie, sighs.

{Shiva} finishes his cosmic dance at the {Front} of the {Hut}, and a giant *question mark* floats over his head: when does the dancer **rest**? A huge *yawn* answers. He sits down, the drum falls silent, the ring of fire dims to one candle, and he takes a long, peaceful **rest**.

{Deadpool} stands at the {Front} of the {Tower} with two katanas and a block of wood on a conveyor *circuit*. He **carves** a tiny *sparrow* so fast that it flaps off the belt. 'Look, I can **carve** too!' he tells the audience. The wooden bird lands on his mask, and Deadpool takes a chimichanga break.

{Madonna} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} behind a locked *gate*, with no dancers and no music. She strikes a pose, then another. Her *heart* sinks. She is **bored**, so **bored** that she reinvents her outfit seven times in one minute just to pass the time.

{RuPaul} sashays into the {Basement} of the {Shed} in a towering wig, carrying a bottle of **milk** for a *hatchling* chick. The chick wobbles in on a tiny *ski*, slides across the floor and slurps the **milk** with a loud cheep. 'Good luck, and don't spill it,' says RuPaul, tapping her heel.

{Chewbacca} roars in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and **strings together** a long *kebab* on a rod: tomato, mushroom, pepper, tomato again, with a growl for each piece. He cannot stop. The skewer is **strung together** from wall to wall, and Chewbacca holds it up like a trophy: dinner is ready.

{Wonder Woman} flies into the {Inside} of the {Spa} to help a *woman* whose **baby** has grabbed the golden lasso and a *jade tablet* as toys. The lasso makes the **baby** tell the truth. The truth is: 'Goo.' Wonder Woman melts, and her super strength goes only into one very gentle cuddle.

{Jim Carrey} slinks into the {Basement} of the {Tower} with a *silk thread* tied round his finger as a reminder: **hand in** the homework! He pulls a face, a *sparkle* of green Mask magic appears, and the whole assignment springs from his pocket, neatly stamped. Ta-da! He **hands in** the paper and bows.

{Houdini} sits locked in a water tank in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, holding his breath. At last he opens his *mouth* to **call**, and a bubble carries the shout up. A *brilliant* spotlight swings round the moment he **calls**. The assistant unlocks the lid, and Houdini steps out, dripping and smiling.

{Yoda} hops into the {Inside} of the {Jungle} for a game of shells. Under one *shell* hides a *winner's purse* full of gold. 'Find it, I will,' says Yoda, and lifts the right shell with the Force. He **wins**! Round after round he **wins**, until a very cross monkey has to hand over all its bananas.

{Lisa Simpson} wades into the {Inside} of the {Mansion}, where a pond has flooded the ballroom, with tall *grass* tickling her knees. A *convoy* of ducklings paddles past in a perfect line. In the middle floats a glowing pink **lotus**. Lisa plays a calm saxophone tune, and the **lotus** opens one petal at a time.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and finds a **tyrant** in a bathrobe riding a *saddle* strapped to the tub, ordering the guests about. *Rain* from a leaking pipe soaks his paper crown. Batman growls that no **tyrant** rules this spa. The soggy **tyrant** is lifted out by grappling hook, quacking his last order.

{Tony Stark} zooms into the {Inside} of the {Tower}, where a small *tree* has sprouted from the *cracked shell* of his old armour. On its branches hang glowing **peaches**. He blasts one loose with a repulsor, and the juicy **peach** drops into his gauntlet. 'Fuzzy,' says JARVIS, and Tony takes a bite.

{Tupac} rhymes in the {Basement} of the {Fort}, hunting for a seat. This chair is too high, that one too low, a third is wobbly. Then he finds a comfy old sofa that has *settled* perfectly into the floor: **suitable**. He sits, nods, and freestyles a verse that this one is the only **suitable** seat in the house.

{Shakira} belly-dances into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and finds an *elder* napping on a *sickbed* cot, so **thin** that he slips between the slats. Her hips don't lie: he is truly **thin**. She shimmies, sings a few waka-waka bars, and brings him a giant sandwich, just a little thicker than he is.

{Darth Vader} wheezes proudly at the {Front} of the {Spa} and Force-lifts bundles of *thatch* into the air to **put up** a hut. A *helping hand* steadies the ladder. He **puts up** the walls, he **puts up** the thatch, and a little hut stands. Vader's helmet tilts: a booming sigh of approval.

{Nick Fury} snaps open his long coat in the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} and draws a *fortune stick* that names the place: the helicarrier. A *runner* dashes off at once. Fury barks that the whole team must **go to** it immediately, and the runner is the first to **go to** the deck, panting, with a salute.

{Usain Bolt} sprints into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and hops over a little *hillock*. That is nothing. The **high mountain** behind it is something else. Bolt zooms up the **high mountain** in seconds, strikes his lightning-bolt pose on the *mountain* top and dances, while a gold medal appears in the clouds.

{Jim Carrey} stands at the {Front} of the {Spa} as a tiny *scholar* in a graduation cap hands him a test. Jim pulls a face of terror, then a face of triumph: 'Alrighty then!' The scholar stamps it: **excellent**! Jim stretches a rubber grin from ear to ear, and every mark he gets today is **excellent**.

{Cookie Monster} lumbers to the {Front} of the {Hangar}, where a little *boat* sits parked in a *barn*. He climbs into its tiny **cabin** and finds shelves stacked with cookies. Crunch! Crumbs fly everywhere. 'Me love this **cabin**!' he roars, and soon the whole **cabin** is knee-deep in crumbs and the boat rocks.

{Juliet} sighs on her balcony in the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} as a *standing person* in a long coat poses below. Beside him waits a *handsome man* with an armful of roses, so **handsome** that she swoons into a bucket of confetti. 'So **handsome**,' she whispers, and drops a single rose.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Basement} of the {Shed} and plants a *stop sign* in a patch of *soil*, claiming it as the **site** of his next big prank. The building **site** will be a squirting flower factory. Workers glance at the sign and stop, and he laughs: only a sign has ever obeyed him.

{Pac-Man} chomps waka waka into the {Inside} of the {Hangar} and finds a *shed* so **huge** that a sleeping *dragon* fits in it. The dragon puffs smoke; Pac-Man munches it like a power pellet and swells, getting **huge** himself. The four ghosts take one look at the **huge** yellow circle and run.

{Garfield} drags a heavy *plough* to the {Front} of the {Jungle}, groaning that it is Monday, again. A *well* nearby gurgles. He kicks Odie into the harness instead, and Odie **ploughs** furrow after furrow while Garfield naps on the seat, eating lasagne. 'I **plough** only by supervising,' he purrs.

{RuPaul} struts into the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} cabin in a sequinned gown and hands a pile of *gold coins* to a *money changer*. 'Make me something sharp,' she says. He melts the coins into golden scissors, so **sharp** they snip a wig curl in mid-air. 'Sashay away!' says RuPaul, wielding the **sharp** new scissors for a very dramatic makeover.

{Fred Flintstone} stoops in the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} lodge and hears a loud RIP: the **seam** of his pants has split. He tries to mend it with a *silk thread*, but a neighbour offers a friendly *handshake*, Fred lunges to take it, and the **seam** rips wider than before. Dino fetches a bigger needle. Yabba dabba doh!

{Houdini} sits in the {Basement} of the {Lake} cabin, chained into a trunk. A beating *standing heart* thumps on the lid, aching, because he **regrets** boasting that he would be out in ten seconds. A *busy mother* with a laundry basket reminds him he said it would be easy. He slips free, but still **regrets** the boast.

{Yoda} stands at the {Front} of the {Tower} at the end of a long *road* and flicks a *sparkle* of Force light down it. The sparkle spells out: you I **invite**, to tea in the swamp. Every traveller on the road receives a glowing note, and Yoda **invites** them all, hopping with joy and stirring a big pot of bog soup.

{Lisa Simpson} plays her saxophone in the {Inside} of the {Jungle} while a *king* lounges on a throne of vines and a *herald* swings a tiny silver bell. **Ting-a-ling**, goes the bell, every time the king nods. **Ting-a-ling**, goes the bell again. Lisa answers each ring with a sax note and a patient sigh.

{Wonder Woman} swoops into the {Inside} of the {Lake} cabin and asks her golden lasso who is home. The lasso tugs: the **only** guest is a single *sparrow*. A cartoon *standing heart* on little legs trots in, the **only** other soul, and curls up beside the bird. She smiles and shuts the door softly.

{Charlie Chaplin} tiptoes into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} and spots a *chipped axe* beside a split log. A policeman mimes: who did this? Chaplin shrugs, tips his bowler, and points at the axe. The policeman wags a finger at the axe, scolding it: he **blames** the axe, and the axe gets all the **blame**.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Inside} of the {Island} cottage, his new **residence**, a *dwelling* with a purple door and a green mat that squirts. Every visitor to the **residence** leaves soaked in glitter and honked at by a rubber horn. 'Welcome home!' he howls, hanging his hat on a trick coat rack.

{Tinker Bell} jingles to the {Front} of the {Mansion} and sneaks a pinch of pixie dust into the cook's soup pot. A *blushing* cook asks for salt, and she **adds** a few *water drops* of sparkling dew. The soup glows. She **adds** one more sparkle, fiery with jealousy that nobody has noticed, until it floats away.

{Wonder Woman} marches to the {Front} of the {Spa} to **dig** a new pool. A *helping hand* passes her a *shovel*, and with her super strength she **digs** a hole the size of a stadium in one scoop. Water gushes in. She leans on the shovel and nods: that is how you **dig**.

{Homer Simpson} flops at the {Front} of the {Hut} after chasing the last doughnut. He opens his *mouth* and **breathes out** a long haaah onto the window, fogging it up. His *nodding head* bobs with each breath. He **breathes out** again, 'Mmm…', and the fog on the glass draws a perfect doughnut.

{Sonic} spins into the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} cabin, a courtroom today, to file a **lawsuit** against the clock for being too slow. A *small speech bubble* pops from his mouth: hurry! He taps his foot while the *public* in the seats waits. The judge reads the **lawsuit**: Sonic against waiting. Sonic wins before the sentence ends.

{Yoda} taps his stick in the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a *sheep* in a tiny mask is breathing *steam* from a swamp pot. 'Oxygen, it needs,' he says. With the Force he lifts a bubble of **oxygen** and pops it under the sheep's nose. The sheep perks up and bleats: only **oxygen** helps.

{Homer Simpson} wades into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, where *water drops* from a leak have grown into a **vast** lake. An *announcer* on the loudspeaker booms about the **vast** sea of tiles. Homer paddles on a giant doughnut, saying D'oh: this lake is too **vast** to cross before lunch.

{Usain Bolt} sprints into the {Basement} of the {Shed} and skids to a stop in the middle of a pillow fight. *Feathers* swirl everywhere. One **feather** lands on his nose. Bolt races to catch every **feather** before it touches the floor, a blur in gold, and finishes holding a perfect bouquet of them.

{Jim Carrey} stands at the {Front} of the {Funfair} behind a fruit stall, weighing apples on a scale, while an *axe* hangs on the sign. 'One **catty**! Two **catty**!' he calls, his face stretching with each number. A **catty** is about half a kilo, and the needle jumps and spins, dizzy, as he mimes lifting it.

{Kung Fu Panda} bounces into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} with a *wine jug* of cold plum juice. An *announcer* declares this the **coolest** move ever: Po sips, bounces his belly, and slips on dark glasses. Skadoosh! Master Oogway, nodding, says he has never seen anyone so **cool**.

{Lucifer} sneaks into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} behind a model *palace* of cardboard. A *helping hand* made of smoke lifts every cookie from the pantry. 'Time to **plunder**,' he giggles. He **plunders** the cookies, the pie shelf, the jam. Then he sulks when the smoke hand eats the last cookie.

{Yoda} stops at the {Front} of the {Tower} where a *woman* in a pointy hat stirs a bubbling cauldron: a **witch**. A *dancer* twirls beside her, spinning the witch's broom like a baton. 'Only a friendly **witch**, she is,' says Yoda, lifting the cauldron lid with the Force to peek at the soup.

{Houdini} readies his greatest trick in the {Bathroom} of the {Fort}, but a *small altar* of props tips over, and a *wok* lands on his head with a loud clang. **Disaster**! His cape is stuck. He wriggles free, bows, and the crowd cheers, sure that the **disaster** was part of the act.

{Shakira} sways into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} dressed as a waiter, a *standing person* with a tray, to **serve** a cake shaped like a *temple*. Her hips don't lie, the tray swings, and every plate lands perfectly at the guests' places. To **serve** with a dance is her specialty, and nobody has ever **served** so smoothly.

{Yoda} waddles into the {Basement} of the {Shed} and counts a line of birds for a race. 'First, the goose is. **Second in order**, the swan.' He pins a medal on the *swan*, whose curly neck bows low. She is **second in order**, and perfectly happy about it, because second has the prettiest neck.

{Fred Flintstone} rolls his foot-powered car into the {Inside} of the {Hangar}, but a quarry foreman, a *woman* in a hard hat, has put a giant *square* block of stone in his way. It **hinders** him! He pushes and it **hinders** him more. Dino finally nudges it aside. Yabba dabba doo!

{Tony Stark} lands at the {Front} of the {Mansion} with a *shell* chest of gold and a *clock* that ticks out more coins every second. He wants all of it. JARVIS clears his throat: sir, you are being **greedy**. Tony grins, scoops up another armful, and admits he is **greedy** but also extremely well dressed.

The {Joker} sets up a *tug of war* in the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} lodge, promising a gold coin to the winner. A *helping hand* grabs the rope and heaves. The winner **earns** a coin, which squirts water in his face. The Joker cackles: that is how you **earn** your pay.

{Wonder Woman} flies to the {Front} of the {Hangar}, where a *king* in a golden crown stands knee-deep as *water drops* from the ceiling swell into an **expanse of water**. She glides over it in her invisible jet, admiring the shimmering **expanse of water**, until the king politely asks if she could maybe lend him a boat.

{Nemo} swims into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, which is a clinic today, where a *lying man* on a bed waits for a test. A nurse sets a cup of *water* and a cup of **urine** side by side on a tray. Dory forgets which is which. Nemo points with his little fin: the yellow one is the **urine**.

{Lisa Simpson} pushes through tall *grass* into the {Bathroom} of the {Shed}, where a white **jasmine** bush grows. She snips a bloom with *sharp* garden shears, and the sweet **jasmine** scent floods the room. Lisa plays a slow saxophone tune that smells exactly like **jasmine**, and her brother even stops complaining.

{Michael Schumacher} climbs a *stepladder* in the {Inside} of the {Mansion} to **hang** his red race suit on a hook. In two seconds flat he **hangs** his helmet, his gloves and the champagne trophy too. Then the pit crew **hangs** a chandelier over the dining table, and he overtakes the butler on the way out.

{Chewbacca} growls his way into the {Inside} of the {Funfair}'s hall of mirrors, where a giant *clam* opens like a *mouth* with two enormous red **lips**. The **lips** purse and plant a smooch on the hairy Wookiee's cheek. Chewbacca roars, bashful, and checks his bandolier for the nearest exit.

{Homer Simpson} yawns in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} at *dawn*, looking for the doughnut recipe, and grabs a **writing brush** instead. He dips it in strawberry jam and writes on the mirror: D'oh. The **writing brush** wobbles, the jam letters drip, and Homer tastes the last stroke of his masterpiece.

{Cookie Monster} stomps to the {Front} of the {Hangar}, where a red *barn* stands stuffed with cookie jars up to the ceiling. He kicks the **barn** door open: cookies everywhere! He nibbles the **barn** wall, which turns out to be gingerbread. 'Me eat **barn**!' he roars, in a spray of crumbs.

{Gru} rolls a mine *cart* into the {Basement} of the {Lake} cabin and finds that the **track** has been pulled up. A Minion pries the rail back with a *crowbar*, and the **track** clanks into place. The cart zooms off along the **track** with Gru clinging on, shouting something about the moon.

{Madonna} twirls into the {Inside} of the {Lake} cabin and taps a *tree* with her *cane*, and gold coins rain down, one **piece** at a time. She strikes a pose for each one: one **piece**, two **pieces**, three. Her dancers catch every shiny **piece** in their hats and kick up a chorus line.

{Yoda} wanders in the {Inside} of the {Mansion}, past a white *salt flat* that has spread across the dining hall floor. With his stick he scoops a little **salt** into a *dish*. 'More **salt**, the swamp stew needs,' he mutters, sprinkling it. A glittering crunch follows his every hop.

{Lara Croft} swings into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} with a *sightseer* in tow, a tourist with a big camera, who just wants to **view** the ancient hall. Lara scales a pillar for the best **view**. The sightseer clicks photos, shouting that this is the finest **view** he has ever had.

{Nick Fury} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Shed} and reads a *proclamation* from a long scroll: the agents have a new **instructor**. A *standing person* in a tracksuit steps forward, whistle between his teeth. Fury nods: your **instructor**. The **instructor** blows the whistle, and the whole team runs laps.

{Shuri} invents a talking mirror in the {Bathroom} of the {Island} cabin and sets it to say one word. Her big brother steps up, a fluffy *towel* wrapped round his head like a turban. The mirror beeps: **handsome**! He poses, and Shuri rolls her eyes: she did not build it to say **handsome** every time.

{Mr. Bean} wanders into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, dragging a *shed* on a skateboard, and sneakily turns it into a **temple**. He sows a *sprouting field* of cress along the steps and seats his teddy as the statue. Visitors bow quietly: such a small, silly, lovable **temple**.

{Fred Flintstone} sniffs the air at the {Front} of the {Funfair}: what a wonderful **fragrance**! It drifts from a *cut cake* on a table, sprinkled with sweet *grass* flowers. Fred follows the **fragrance** nose-first, Dino sniffing behind him, straight into the icing.

{Deadpool} stands at the {Front} of the {Shed} listening to a *dripping tap* that goes **drip**, **drip**. *Water drops* **drip** on the brim of his mask. {Shuri} kneels at the {Front} of the {Shed} with a hologram of a blocked pipe floating above her wrist. She builds a sonic plunger to **clear away** the muck. Whoosh! {Charlie Chaplin} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, holding a *sincere* love note on a *page*. He mimes his knees knocking: he **trembles**. The page **trembles** too. {Charlie Chaplin} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} and meets a *clown* in an **ugly** green wig and mismatched shoes. {Lisa Simpson} frowns in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} at a science fair, where a rival's robot lifts a bowling ball. Her own robot has a puny *strong arm* and lifts only a *few* paperclips. {King Kong} climbs the *tree* at the {Front} of the {Hut} and snaps off a **branch** to scratch his back. {Rocky} jogs to the {Front} of the {Jungle} gym, ties a *ribbon* round a boxing glove and **throws** it at the punching bag. A *helping hand* passes him another glove, and he **throws** that too. {Juliet} sighs on her balcony in the {Bathroom} of the {Shed}, while a *standing person* below hands up a *toolbox* holding **all** her gifts: the roses, the love letters, and **all** the tiny ribbons. She clutches the box to her heart and swoons that it is **all** hers.

{Fred Flintstone} stands at the {Front} of the {Jungle} lodge when a striped, buzzing *bug* zooms in: a **bee**. It lands on a *peak* of honey on his head, a tiny mountain of sticky cream. {Jim Carrey} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Funfair} carrying a fragile *clay* pot, so **careful** that he walks like a cartoon cat. A *small speech bubble* pops out of his head: be **careful**!
